script_text: Aquarius, this week the cosmic currents are shifting rapidly, demanding your adaptability as an Air sign ruled by Uranus. Early on, Monday and Tuesday bring a challenging square between Mars in your 10th House of career and Saturn in your 4th House of home, creating professional friction and domestic tension. Wednesday marks a brilliant mid-week turning point as Venus enters your 5th House of romance, forming a joyful trine to Jupiter in your 11th House of social hopes. This transit unlocks love and creative flow. By late week, a Full Moon in your 7th House of partnerships demands balance in your closest relationships. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, while Tuesday is your worst day due to the stressful Mars-Saturn square. This week, channel your innovative Uranus energy by setting clear boundaries in business deals. Follow for daily updates.
